answer.reason: In the EIA Indiana Electricity Profile's Table 1 (net generation by producer type), the IPP & CHP (independent power producers and combined heat and power) category is listed with approximately 37 million megawatthours, while the larger figure (~60 million MWh) corresponds to traditional electric power generators (investor-owned/other utilities). Thus, 37,060,955 MWh is the IPP & CHP value, and 59,951,925 MWh is the utility generators value.
